entries.question: Issue 6450 bundles seven observations. Which of them does this Mission take, and what stays out?
entries.rationale: The 2026-10-27 maintainer comment splits the bundle by observation and groups (4) tracked workspace-context deletions in consolidate, (6) the push/PR hint on coord topology and (7) the issue-verdict hint printed when every row has a verdict into one slice over the same files; #6715, the blocker it waited on, is closed. Item (1) needs its own issue after the Java write-core commit design, (2) needs the exact reproducing invocation, (3) is the duplicate of the closed #6386, and (5) needs the concrete stale-assertion fixture. The operator standing guidance for this batch is that a bundled issue is delivered as the coherent slice with the remainder named in the PR.
